messages:
Eli Wang: Hi team — first day and hitting a weird MDM/Device Trust problem after I updated to macOS Ventura 13.6. Profiles app shows the Redwood MDM profile as "Pending" and Company Portal says "Device not registered". Okta device trust doesn't pick up the machine so I can't access some internal apps. MBP M2, serial C02X1ABCDEG. Anyone seen this post-update?

Karen (IT): Welcome, Eli! Congrats and sorry for the snag. Can you run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and `profiles status -type enrollment` and paste output? Also confirm if Wi‑Fi used a captive portal (hotel/campus) during the update.

Eli Wang: Ran the commands — output below. No captive portal, home Wi‑Fi.
```
$ sudo profiles status -type enrollment
Enrollment: Pending
Managed by: com.redwood.mdm
Last check-in: 2026-03-22 14:12:03 +0000
Error: 403 Certificate mismatch during server auth
```

MDM Bot: Enrollment event recorded: device_serial=C02X1ABCDEG status=failed reason="cert_mismatch" timestamp=2026-03-22T14:12:05Z

Sam - DevEx: Welcome Eli! Quick note — sometimes Apple updates change kernel extension trust or the MDM cert chain needs a refresh. If Karen wants to try a re-enroll, the safe sequence is: (1) Remove existing profile from Profiles.app, (2) sign out of Okta SSO, (3) re-enroll via Company Portal URL.

Karen (IT): Thanks Sam. Eli — can you open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles and try to remove the Redwood MDM profile? If the Remove button is greyed out, post a screenshot. If you prefer, we can do a remote session.

Eli Wang: Remove is greyed out. Screenshot: [uploaded]. Also tried reboot.

Leo S.: I hit this once — Company Portal sometimes leaves stale MDM certs. IT usually issues a one-time enrollment token to bootstrap. Karen, can you generate a temporary device-token for serial C02X1ABCDEG?

Karen (IT): Creating a one-time enrollment token now. ETA ~5m. Also @IT Support, can you check the enrollment cert chain for that serial?

IT Support: Checking certs — we see the device presented an intermediate signed by an old CA. We'll revoke the old pending registration and clear server side record so a fresh cert can be issued.

MDM Bot: Action: server_record_cleared device_serial=C02X1ABCDEG by=it.support timestamp=2026-03-22T14:25:40Z

Karen (IT): Token created: ONE-TIME-ENROLL-XY12. Steps: System Settings > Profiles > Remove stale profile (if still present), then open Company Portal > Enroll and paste the token when prompted. If it still fails, hop on a quick screen-share and we can push a temporary admin elevation for the session.

Eli Wang: Re-enrolled with the token and Company Portal shows "Managed". Okta device trust now recognizes the device. Verified access to internal apps. Thanks everyone!! :tada:

Julia (People Ops): Welcome again, Eli — glad that worked. Ping me if you need any extra perms for your first-week tooling.

Karen (IT): Great — marking this resolved. Flagging the event for follow-up with Apple CA rotation team to avoid more of these post-update cert mismatches.

Eli Wang: Thanks Karen, Sam, Leo, IT Support and Julia — appreciate the help. :thumbsup:
